```{=html}
<div class="diagram-container">
  <style>
    .diagram-container svg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 560px;
      overflow: visible;
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
    }

    .box {
      fill: white;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 1.8;
    }

    .group-box {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 2.2;
      stroke-dasharray: 10 6;
    }

    .arrow {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 2.2;
      marker-end: url(#arrow);
    }

    .thin-arrow {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 1.8;
      marker-end: url(#arrowSmall);
    }

    .connector {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 2.2;
    }

    .highlight-arrow {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 4.4;
      marker-end: url(#arrowBold);
    }

    .highlight-connector {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 4.4;
    }

    .erase-line {
      fill: none;
      stroke: white;
      stroke-width: 5.8;
    }

    .negative-arrow {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 2.2;
      stroke-dasharray: 8 6;
      marker-end: url(#arrow);
    }

    .negative-connector {
      fill: none;
      stroke: black;
      stroke-width: 2.2;
      stroke-dasharray: 8 6;
    }

    .label-bg {
      fill: white;
    }

    .main-label {
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    .small-label {
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .tiny-label {
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .sign-label {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .reveal .diagram-container svg .fragment {
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
    }

    .reveal .diagram-container svg .fragment.visible {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  </style>

  <svg viewBox="0 0 1200 560" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-label="Business analytics diagram">
    <defs>
      <marker id="arrow"
              viewBox="0 0 10 10"
              markerWidth="6"
              markerHeight="6"
              refX="10"
              refY="5"
              orient="auto">
        <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 Z" fill="black"></path>
      </marker>

      <marker id="arrowSmall"
              viewBox="0 0 10 10"
              markerWidth="5"
              markerHeight="5"
              refX="10"
              refY="5"
              orient="auto">
        <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 Z" fill="black"></path>
      </marker>

      <marker id="arrowBold"
              viewBox="0 0 10 10"
              markerWidth="7"
              markerHeight="7"
              refX="10"
              refY="5"
              orient="auto">
        <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 Z" fill="black"></path>
      </marker>
    </defs>

    <!-- Main boxes -->
    <rect class="box" x="40" y="245" width="110" height="55"></rect>
    <text x="95" y="272" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" class="main-label">Data</text>

    <rect class="box" x="190" y="185" width="135" height="165"></rect>
    <text x="257.5" y="230" text-anchor="middle" class="main-label">
      <tspan x="257.5" dy="0">Business</tspan>
      <tspan x="257.5" dy="24">Analytics</tspan>
      <tspan x="257.5" dy="24">system</tspan>
    </text>

    <rect class="box" x="380" y="245" width="125" height="55"></rect>
    <text x="442.5" y="272" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" class="main-label">Information</text>

    <rect class="box" x="550" y="245" width="125" height="55"></rect>
    <text x="612.5" y="272" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" class="main-label">Knowledge</text>

    <rect class="box" x="735" y="245" width="110" height="55"></rect>
    <text x="790" y="272" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" class="main-label">Decision</text>

    <rect class="box" x="895" y="245" width="110" height="55"></rect>
    <text x="950" y="272" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" class="main-label">Action</text>

    <rect class="box" x="1060" y="245" width="110" height="55"></rect>
    <text x="1115" y="272" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" class="main-label">Value</text>

    <!-- Main flow arrows -->
    <line class="arrow" x1="150" y1="272" x2="190" y2="272"></line>
    <line class="arrow" x1="325" y1="272" x2="380" y2="272"></line>
    <line class="arrow" x1="505" y1="272" x2="550" y2="272"></line>
    <line class="arrow" x1="675" y1="272" x2="735" y2="272"></line>
    <line class="arrow" x1="845" y1="272" x2="895" y2="272"></line>
    <line class="arrow" x1="1005" y1="272" x2="1060" y2="272"></line>

    <!-- Processes -->
    <rect class="group-box" x="705" y="90" width="335" height="230"></rect>
    <rect class="label-bg" x="730" y="78" width="145" height="22"></rect>
    <text x="735" y="94" class="small-label">Other processes</text>

    <rect class="group-box" x="720" y="120" width="310" height="195"></rect>
    <rect class="label-bg" x="745" y="108" width="150" height="22"></rect>
    <text x="750" y="124" class="small-label">Supported process</text>

    <!-- Interrelated decisions/actions -->
    <rect class="box" x="730" y="160" width="120" height="50"></rect>
    <text x="790" y="178" text-anchor="middle" class="tiny-label">
      <tspan x="790" dy="0">Interrelated</tspan>
      <tspan x="790" dy="16">decisions</tspan>
    </text>

    <rect class="box" x="890" y="160" width="120" height="50"></rect>
    <text x="950" y="178" text-anchor="middle" class="tiny-label">
      <tspan x="950" dy="0">Interrelated</tspan>
      <tspan x="950" dy="16">actions</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Internal links -->
    <line class="thin-arrow" x1="850" y1="185" x2="890" y2="185"></line>
    <line class="thin-arrow" x1="790" y1="210" x2="790" y2="245"></line>
    <line class="thin-arrow" x1="950" y1="210" x2="950" y2="245"></line>

    <!-- Cross links -->
    <line class="thin-arrow" x1="850" y1="210" x2="950" y2="245"></line>
    <line class="thin-arrow" x1="890" y1="210" x2="790" y2="245"></line>

    <!-- Base decision automation path -->
    <path class="arrow" d="M442.5,300 V350 H950 V300"></path>
    <text x="700" y="378" text-anchor="middle" class="small-label">
      Decision augmentation and automation
    </text>

    <!-- Base knowledge transfer path -->
    <rect class="label-bg" x="600" y="42" width="190" height="22"></rect>
    <text x="605" y="58" class="small-label">Knowledge accumulation and transfer</text>
    <path class="connector" d="M612.5,245 V70 H935"></path>
    <path class="arrow" d="M865,70 V90"></path>
    <path class="arrow" d="M935,70 V120"></path>

    <!-- Base feedback path -->
    <rect class="label-bg" x="340" y="0" width="120" height="22"></rect>
    <text x="345" y="16" class="small-label">Feedback</text>
    <path class="connector" d="M585,245 V28 H95"></path>
    <path class="arrow" d="M95,28 V245"></path>
    <path class="arrow" d="M257.5,28 V185"></path>
    <path class="connector" d="M980,90 V28 H585"></path>

    <!-- Fragment 1: Autonomy -->
    <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
      <path class="highlight-arrow" d="M442.5,300 V350 H950 V300"></path>
      <text x="845" y="378" class="sign-label">+</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Fragment 2: Dynamism -->
    <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
      <path class="highlight-connector" d="M585,245 V28 H95"></path>
      <path class="highlight-arrow" d="M95,28 V245"></path>
      <path class="highlight-arrow" d="M257.5,28 V185"></path>
      <path class="highlight-connector" d="M980,90 V28 H585"></path>
      <text x="470" y="16" class="sign-label">+</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Fragment 3: Opacity -->
    <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="3">
      <!-- weaken Information -> Knowledge -->
      <line class="erase-line" x1="505" y1="272" x2="550" y2="272"></line>
      <line class="negative-arrow" x1="505" y1="272" x2="550" y2="272"></line>
      <text x="527.5" y="235" text-anchor="middle" class="sign-label">−</text>

      <!-- weaken Knowledge -> Decision -->
      <line class="erase-line" x1="675" y1="272" x2="735" y2="272"></line>
      <line class="negative-arrow" x1="675" y1="272" x2="735" y2="272"></line>
      <text x="705" y="235" text-anchor="middle" class="sign-label">−</text>

      <!-- weaken knowledge transfer path -->
      <path class="erase-line" d="M612.5,245 V70 H935"></path>
      <path class="erase-line" d="M865,70 V90"></path>
      <path class="erase-line" d="M935,70 V120"></path>

      <path class="negative-connector" d="M612.5,245 V70 H935"></path>
      <path class="negative-arrow" d="M865,70 V90"></path>
      <path class="negative-arrow" d="M935,70 V120"></path>

      <text x="800" y="58" class="sign-label">−</text>
    </g>
  </svg>
</div>
```
